entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioner has challenged the notice dated 21.08.2023 issued by the District Land Acquisition Officer, Dumka whereby the petitioner has been directed to refund a sum of Rs.19,30,324/- on the ground that the same has been paid in excess on account of interest.
3. It is admitted case of the parties that the land of the petitioner was acquired and award was prepared under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The compensation has also been paid.
4. The State after three years suddenly realized that they have paid Rs.19,30,324/-in excess by way of interest, thus this notice has been issued seeking refund.
5. I have gone through the notice, which is at Annexure- 1.
The same only mention that Rs.19,30,324/- has been paid in excess on the head of interest, thus, the same has to be refunded.
The notice does not even reflect as to how the said amount is found in excess of the actual amount which the petitioner has received.
There is no calculation with the notice nor even the principal amount which the petitioner is entitled to and the breakup of the yearly interest has been mentioned in the notice.
When this type of vague notice is issued it is impossible for a person to give appropriate reply or to respond to the said notice.

Since the notice is vague, I am inclined to quash the said notice with a liberty to the State to issue a fresh notice giving all details and calculation to show as to how they have arrived at a conclusion that this amount of Rs.19,30,324/- has been paid Kali Ray @ Kali Rai vs The State Of Jharkhand on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107194899/
1 in excess.

sentences.text: 6. With the aforesaid observation, the instant writ petition stands disposed of.
